Garage description
Due to its high resistance to prolonged contact with salty water, smart tankers use this color to paint their tanks from the inside, using it as a large barrel for salting cucumbers during wintertime.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Legacy paint description:
This paint gives your tank basic defense against Firebird and is good for short-range battles. Sports a natural masking texture that makes the tank harder to spot.
The paint was added to containers on January 14th, 2022.
